data.title: Fenerbahce vs Alanyaspor Tips - Super Lig
data.content:
Fenerbahce (4-2-3-1) Ederson; Nelson Semedo, Milan Skriniar, Nathan Ake, Archie Brown; N'Golo Kante, Matteo Guendouzi; Mason Greenwood, Marco Asensio, Kerem Akturkoglu; Vedat Muriqi  
  
Fenerbahce have to handle multiple availability concerns across their squad, as Mert Hakan Yandas serves a suspension while Emre Mor, Caglar Soyuncu, and Jayden Oosterwolde remain sidelined with injuries. [...] Fenerbahce are set to face Alanyaspor in the Super Lig, with recent form and historical advantage on their side. Alanyaspor have averaged just two goals per game and often struggle against Fenerbahce, who are tipped to secure their third league win in a row. The match is expected to feature fewer than four goals.
